posts.text:

posts.text:

Matthew Modabber was reportedly ousted after an internal probe of several instances of misconduct, according to the New York Post.

Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.

posts.text:

Senator Richard Blumenthal, the ranking Democrat on the investigations subcommittee, added a probe of the ex-White House crypto adviser to his list of crypto interests.

A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
The venture investor behind early bets on Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap said is broadening its focus, joining other crypto investment firms looking beyond blockchain to artificial intelligence and tech themes.

posts.text:

The company is in talks with Visa over a potential $2.5 billion acquisition, Axios reported.

posts.author: www.coindesk.com
posts.text:
Crypto is making a splash in U.S. elections — but chiefly in jabs about industry influence
Boosters often say crypto voters can swing elections, but Democrats are seeking mileage out of tying crypto to Trump, corruption and attempts to buy seats in Congress.

posts.text:
Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

posts.text:
Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

posts.text:
Live updates: Bitcoin falls back to $81,000, with interest rates tumbling as stocks crack
The Nasdaq is down more than 2% as the AI bull market trade continues to unwind. U.S. interest rates are plunging even as oil surges.

Technology shares led regional losses as mixed U.S. earnings unsettled investors and Brent crude climbed above $112 a barrel.

catalog.name: market_overview
catalog.description: Delivery: a compact market-regime evidence pack with sentiment, market totals, dominance, movers, and explicit data gaps. Use when: an agent needs a broad market briefing before token research. Core inputs: none. Limits: research context only; incomplete lanes are marked partial or unavailable.

catalog.name: scan_market
catalog.description: Delivery: a ranked candidate set with price, momentum, market-activity evidence, filters, and reasons where available. Use when: an agent needs a shortlist before deeper token analysis. Core inputs: optional chain, theme, and top_n. Limits: theme is contextual rather than a strict filter; a scan is not a trade instruction.

catalog.name: analyze_token
catalog.description: Delivery: a single-token research pack with USD market data, multi-window performance, calculated RSI and ATR, intelligence, summary, and warnings. Use when: an agent needs a quick structured token read. Core input: symbol. Limits: missing measurements are reported as unavailable and the result is not execution advice.

chain.description: Chain slug for contract-specific safety, e.g. eth/bsc (optional).

catalog.name: deep_analysis
catalog.description: Delivery: a deeper token evidence pack combining market context, confluence, technicals, an optional Skill Hub token profile, derivatives, catalysts, risks, and a measured-ATR preview plan. Use when: an agent needs one comprehensive token read. Core input: token symbol; optional include_perp. Limits: token analysis only, not wallet analysis; unavailable lanes remain explicit and no trade is placed.

catalog.name: compare_tokens
catalog.description: Delivery: a side-by-side comparison of two to four tokens with factor winners, coverage by token, an overall pick, rationale, confidence, and conclusion method. Use when: an agent must compare relative momentum, market activity, and volatility using common data. Core inputs: symbols; optional intent. Limits: missing factors are disclosed and deterministic conclusions are labelled.

symbols.description: 2-4 token symbols to compare, comma- or space-separated, e.g. 'SOL, AVAX'.

intent.description: Trade horizon the pick is for: swing | hold | spot (optional).

catalog.name: monitor_market_sentiment_shift
catalog.description: Delivery: a seven-day market sentiment evidence pack containing Fear & Greed level and change, BTC perpetual funding crowding, BTC liquidation pressure and side, altseason phase, the combined regime, observation dates, coverage scope, and full measurements. Use when: an agent needs to check whether market sentiment materially shifted. Core inputs: optional time_window fixed to 7d. Limits: market-wide context except for BTC-referenced derivatives; no causality claim or advice.

time_window.description: Sentiment comparison window; currently fixed to seven days.
